name: Kaya's Alive
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: Tell Tammra Windfield, Kaya's aunt who's at Sun Rock Retreat, about the good news! Kaya is alive! We had thought she was lost after the brutal attack on our village. Follow the path to the west to get to Sun Rock Retreat.
narrative.objectives: Tell Tammra Windfield in Sun Rock Retreat the good news.
narrative.offerRewardText: My goodness, my niece Kaya is alive! That is good news indeed. Thank you, adventurer.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 18, 2,350 XP in all.

quests.name: Protect Kaya
quests.objectiveText: Escort Kaya Flathoof to Camp Aparaje, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

quests.name: Kaya's Alive
quests.objectiveText: Tell Tammra Windfield in Sun Rock Retreat the good news.
